summary: AIM ImmunoTech Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to suspend its at-the-market equity offering under an existing Equity Distribution Agreement with Maxim Group LLC. The offering had registered up to $3,409,174 of common stock, of which $2,847,151 had been sold as of the filing date. The supplement does not terminate the agreement but halts further sales until a new prospectus supplement is filed. The stock closed at $0.4080 per share on May 18, 2026. This is a routine suspension of a continuous offering, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other special category is triggered. The filing is a shelf takedown pause, not a transformative event.
